prospects.subject: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (REQ-001) — Bilal Kazmi
prospects.body:
Hi Draxion team,

Your Senior Full-Stack Engineer opening caught my attention because it combines TypeScript, Next.js and PostgreSQL with practical AI governance.

I'm a senior full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience across React, Next.js, Node.js, Python and AWS. At JAL Tech, I built React/Node applications serving 1,000+ daily users, an internal RAG assistant, and a Gemini Vision receipt workflow handling about 1,000 receipts per day that reduced review time from roughly ten minutes to one.

I'd be interested in owning product features across your detection and reporting workflows. I'm based in Islamabad, Pakistan (UTC+5); could you confirm whether this location is eligible and the US-hours overlap you need?

GitHub: https://github.com/bilalk711
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bilal-kazmi

Best,
Bilal Kazmi

prospects.body:
Hi Thunderclap team,

Your storefront, checkout and customer-dashboard work looks closely aligned with what I've shipped. I also noticed the focus on mobile Core Web Vitals and preventing recurring build problems.

I'm a senior full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience in React, TypeScript, Next.js and Node.js. prospects.subject: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — console and orchestration — Bilal Kazmi
prospects.body:
Hi Claws team,

Your Senior Full-Stack Engineer opening maps well to my experience building product interfaces alongside the services that run them. The TypeScript/Next.js console and Node/Mongo orchestration work particularly caught my attention.

I have 5+ years of full-stack experience. I founded CloneVoicePrompt, using Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis/BullMQ, Cloudflare R2 and GPU workers. Optimizing Qwen3-TTS with chunked generation and CUDA graphs reduced GPU cost for an hour of generated audio from about $0.50 to $0.09. At JAL Tech, I also built production React/Node applications and an internal RAG assistant.

I'm based in Islamabad, Pakistan (UTC+5). Is the role open to this location, and what EU/US overlap would you require?

Project: https://clonevoiceprompt.online
GitHub: https://github.com/bilalk711

Best,
Bilal Kazmi
